problem: Public runtime EPOCH projection can lag rapidly advancing main during claim bursts, causing mandatory prewrite freshness checks to record inconsistent epoch/head pairs without an explicit coherence policy.
acceptance: measure and classify epoch vs main drift from durable claim/run receipts during one swarm burst
define deterministic safe-write policy separating append-only isolated candidate writes from shared authority/product mutations when epoch lags
produce machine-readable coherence receipt with epoch id/head, live main head, observed_at, drift state and source refs
tests fail closed for shared authority mutation when coherence is unresolved while allowing explicitly scoped append-only create-if-absent claims if contract permits
title: Runtime EPOCH/main coherence guard
mission: Build and verify a deterministic prewrite coherence guard for fast swarm activity: compare the public runtime EPOCH projection with the observed live main head and durable claim/run evidence, classify projection lag explicitly, emit a machine-readable coherence receipt, and enforce separate safe behavior for isolated append-only/CAS candidate writes versus shared authority or product mutations. Preserve the existing EPOCH-before-write law; do not weaken it or self-promote authority.

regression_prevention.reason: Multiple live canary claims now record EPOCH/main drift while repository writes continue under preserve-first rules; an explicit coherence contract prevents workers from silently treating a lagging projection as fresh authority evidence.

unblock_value.reason: The stable entry and AGENTS contract require EPOCH validation before material writes. A deterministic lag classification can make rapid high-parallelism prewrite checks auditable without weakening shared-authority gates.

reuse_value.reason: One coherence receipt/guard can be reused by worker claims, recovery attempts, Page Change writes, Planner integration and future production /w rather than each worker inventing a runtime_drift_note convention.

fail_if: the guard treats public EPOCH lag as proof that live main is stale or vice versa without source evidence
an unresolved coherence state permits shared Current/Human Accepted/Served or product mutation
append-only candidate/CAS writes are globally blocked solely because the public projection lags even when their scoped contract explicitly permits safe creation
the receipt omits either observed EPOCH provenance or live main provenance
the implementation weakens the existing EPOCH-before-write requirement
falsification.pass_if: A replay of a rapid swarm claim burst deterministically classifies coherent/lagging/unresolved states, emits source-linked receipts, fails closed for shared-authority mutation when unresolved, and preserves explicitly authorized isolated append-only/CAS behavior without authority promotion.
